from pathlib import Path
import sys,datetime as dt,hashlib,json,subprocess
E=Path('/home/omaltsev/stage17-owner-evidence/local-authoring-cpuprefetchv5-25');R=E/'admission-root';P=E/'formal-q16a-continuation-authoring-1';AUTH=R/'evidence/formal-q16a-1';A=E.parent/'cpu-prefetch-pilot-candidate-2.0.0-42f2ebb-clean-e808f93edb5a.tar.gz'
sys.path[:0]=[str(E/'d242-admin-1'),str(R/'tools')]
import stage17_operational_cli_v18 as cli
import stage17_state_journal_v53 as recovery
import stage17_phase_controller_v26 as controller
cli.activate();recovery.activate();recovery.admin_binding()
assert not (AUTH/'authorization.json').exists() and not (AUTH/'authorization.json.sig').exists()
plan=json.loads((P/'plan.json').read_bytes());request=json.loads((AUTH/'request.json').read_bytes())
assert request['action_inputs']['plan']==plan and request['request_id']=='CPU-PREFETCH-V5-V25-Q16A-REQUEST-1'
before=hashlib.sha256((AUTH/'request.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
extent=controller.contract.validate_plan('Q16a',plan);policy=controller.deadline_policy(extent)
now=dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)
stamp=lambda value:value.isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')
cli.author_formal_authorization(repository_root=R,evidence_root=E,pilot_archive=A,pilot_sidecar=Path(str(A)+'.sha256'),request_path=AUTH/'request.json',actor='maltsev.oiu@phystech.edu',reviewer='OWNER',issued_at_utc=stamp(now),expires_at_utc=stamp(now+dt.timedelta(seconds=policy['session_max_wall_seconds'])),destination=AUTH/'authorization.json')
assert hashlib.sha256((AUTH/'request.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ssh-keygen','-Y','sign','-f','/home/omaltsev/.ssh/id_ed25519','-n','stage17-owner-acceptance',str(AUTH/'authorization.json')],check=True,timeout=15)
print(json.dumps({name:dict(size_bytes=(AUTH/name).stat().st_size,sha256=hashlib.sha256((AUTH/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for name in ['request.json','authorization.json','authorization.json.sig']}),flush=True)
